title.narrative: Livelihoods and Food Security Technical Assistance II (LIFT II)

description.narrative: The Livelihoods and Food Security Technical Assistance II (LIFT II) project strengthens the continuum of care for people living with HIV and other at-risk households by providing technical assistance that connects health sector clients with context-appropriate, market-led economic strengthening, livelihoods and food security (ES/L/FS) opportunities.
